column4: cleat#2324: both tests open a *PostgresStore directly via testutil.TestDB(t, testutil.DialectPostgres), which skips on CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES alone regardless of what else is set -- payload encryption is PostgreSQL-only (--encrypt-sensitive-payloads already refuses every other --driver), so these two have no MySQL or MSSQL form to run instead. multi-db/mysql sets CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL and not CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES, so both skip here. 2 skips, not a subtest pair -- each test is its own top-level skip, same shape as idempotency-key-retention-is-safe-on-a-non-utc-mysql-session.tsv's single-test entries.
same two tests, same reason: multi-db/mssql sets CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL and not CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES, so both skip here too -- see the multi-db/mysql line above.
